text:
rachel: FYI Sev2 from BrightCart on Dedicated - they've got sustained 429s during a burst and scale-up is taking >90s. Customer saw requests queueing, then brief 429 flood. 

alex: Can you paste the logs / request traces? Which pool/region?

rachel: region: us-west-2, pool: dc-prod-gpu-a. Customer traffic spike ~600rps -> targeting to 1200rps. We saw probe queueing and many container attach retries. Sample trace: 
```
2026-03-17T14:02:01Z request_id=rc-23 status=queued reason=min_replicas_floor
2026-03-17T14:02:12Z attach_attempt=1 imagepull=backoff auth=OK
2026-03-17T14:02:38Z attach_attempt=2 imagepull=backoff auth=denied token=rotated
2026-03-17T14:03:15Z scale_event=triggered desired=8 actual=2
2026-03-17T14:04:35Z rate_limit=429 reason=probe_timeout
```

rachel: customer also reported 503s for a short window and elevated latency before 429s.

maria: Two quick suspects: 1) image registry pull rate limiting + transient auth token rotation causing attach handoffs; 2) minReplicas floor set low but warm chain handoff slow (warmpool probes suppressed).

jim: Confirmed in infra metrics: node imagepull queue spiked and kubelet pull-backoff counts rose. Also autoscaler backlog increased because probes timed out waiting for attach.

alex: Any recent changes to min/max config for that tenant? Or burst credit used?

rachel: Tenant has minReplicas=2 maxReplicas=50. They had reserved burst but it didn't materialize; billing shows reserved capacity available but attach failed due to imagepull/auth flakiness.

ops-bot: [alert] warm-pool-heartbeat-missed - pool=dc-prod-gpu-a count=3 first_miss=2026-03-17T13:59:12Z

oncall-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-1192 - Dedicated scale-up degraded (assigned oncall: alex)

maria: Repro steps I'm trying locally: 1) set a short-lived auth token rotation in staging; 2) throttle registry to 50 pulls/min; 3) blast 800->1500rps. Observed same attach backoff and autoscaler lag.

alex: Good repro. Short-term mitigation: 1) bump minReplicas to 6 for this tenant to reduce cold attach count; 2) temporarily allow imagepull from fallback registry mirror; 3) pause token rotation for their tenant if possible. Who can authorize a quick min bump?

rachel: I can request in the account portal; CS reached out and approved temporary bump for BrightCart. Doing the change now.

jim: Also recommend enabling probe jitter/backoff tuning to avoid probe suppression cascade. Current probe interval=5s with aggressive exponential backoff. For large bursts, backoff causes long gaps. Suggest probe interval=3s, max_backoff=20s for this pool.

maria: Long-term: add fair-share queuing at attach-layer so a noisy tenant doesn't monopolize warmpool attach bandwidth. Also add registry pull caching on node image cache layer.

alex: For next actions: (1) Rachel - confirm minReplicas bump applied and monitor; (2) Jim - open infra PR for probe tuning and add runbook entry; (3) Maria - keep repro harness running and capture kernel/imagepull traces; (4) I'll follow up with Billing/Provisioning to verify reserved burst gating isn't blocked by IAM.

rachel: Min bump done at 14:12 UTC. Customer reporting drop in 429s within 30s. Monitoring shows new nodes attaching, but two imagepulls still backoff.

ops-bot: [metric] attach_latency_p95=85s -> after min-bump attach_latency_p95=12s (30s after change)

alex: Great. Assigning follow-ups: jim -> infra PR (#847) probe-tuning, maria -> repro artifacts + registry-mock results, rachel -> confirm customer cold path after 2h and close if stable.

rachel: Will monitor for 2h then update CS. Customer is happy with temporary fix. :thumbsup:

maria: Adding note: consider adding a preflight probe that validates imagepull/auth before consuming warm chain token to avoid wasted attach capacity.

jim: Filing a small telemetry flag to detect imagepull-backoff bursts per-tenant so we can auto-deprioritize noisy tenants.

alex: Thanks team. We'll keep this incident open until warmchain is stable for the customer and the infra PR is merged.

rachel: Closing update in 2hrs unless we see regression.
